system.description:
You wrap a thin sheet of metal around a willing allied creatures body to greatly increase their defensive capabilities. For the duration of this Jutsu the affected creature gains gain 8d6 temporary hit points, and 5 DR while they have temporary hit points granted by this jutsu.

While a creatures has temporary hit points granted by this jutsu they are counted as an Earthen Artifact. When the temporary Hit Points provided by this jutsu reach 0 the jutsu ends.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the temporary hit points by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, the dice used to determine the hit points this jutsu provides, becomes a d10.
